The faithfulness metric measures the factual consistency of the generated answer against the retrieved context. It identifies claims made in the answer and verifies whether each claim can be inferred directly from the retrieved contexts.

Certain Ragas metrics such as faithfulness and answer relevancy are reference-free, meaning they evaluate generation quality without requiring reference ground truth labels. In contrast, context recall requires a ground truth reference answer.

Ragas is an evaluation framework designed to assess the performance of Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines without requiring manual human annotations. It provides automated metrics to evaluate both retrieval and generation components independently.
